name: Overhead Cable V-Bar Extension
description: An overhead triceps extension using a V-bar or angled bar attachment on a low cable pulley. The V-bar allows a neutral-ish grip angle that reduces wrist stress compared to straight bar variations. The overhead cable pull maximizes long head stretch.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Overhead Cable V-Bar Extension in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Overhead Cable V-Bar Extension.
steps: Step 1: Attach V-bar to low pulley. Face away and hold bar overhead.
Step 2: Bend elbows to lower bar behind head, keeping upper arms by ears.
Step 3: Lower until forearms pass parallel and long head is stretched.
Step 4: Press overhead to full extension.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Brace with elbows tight to head
